# hidden-edges-from-wiki-page-filtering

Relationships where either endpoint slug starts with 'wiki-page/' are dropped from get_entity's returned edges. Relevant relationships may be omitted from results, producing an incomplete relationship view.

- `knowledge_compiler/mcp/queries.py` — `knowledge_compiler.mcp.queries.get_entity`
